en.headline: Amber Rainstorm Warning cancelled; thunderstorms still expected until noon
en.dek: The Observatory cancelled the Amber Rainstorm Warning at 10:15 a.m. after downgrading from Red earlier, and extended the Thunderstorm Warning until 12:30 p.m.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory cancelled the Amber Rainstorm Warning Signal at 10:15 a.m. on Thursday, after replacing the morning’s Red Rainstorm Warning with Amber at 9:20 a.m. as rainfall eased.

The Thunderstorm Warning issued at 5:20 a.m. on Wednesday was extended until 12:30 p.m. today. The Observatory said a few thunderstorms were still expected over Hong Kong and advised people outdoors to seek shelter, stay off the water and keep away from high ground and conductive objects.

A Red Rainstorm Warning had been in force from 5:05 a.m., and the Education Bureau suspended morning and whole-day school classes. The bureau said afternoon classes would proceed as usual if the Red signal was cancelled or lowered to Amber at or before 10:30 a.m. The Home Affairs Department opened temporary shelters during the heavy rain.
The Observatory forecast mainly cloudy weather with showers easing later, and a high of about 30 degrees Celsius. Friday and Saturday were expected to bring a few showers and hot conditions by day.

zh.headline: 黃色暴雨警告取消 雷暴警告延長至中午12時半
zh.dek: 天文台上午10時15分取消黃色暴雨警告，紅雨今早一度生效後已改發黃雨；雷暴警告延長至下午12時30分。
body: 天文台今日上午10時15分取消黃色暴雨警告信號。紅雨警告今早5時05分發出後，已於9時20分改發黃雨，隨後雨勢減弱。
天文台將周三上午5時20分發出的雷暴警告延長至今日下午12時30分，預料本港仍有幾陣雷暴，呼籲市民身處室外時到安全地方躲避，離開水面，並遠離高地及導電物體。
教育局因紅雨警告宣布所有上午校及全日制學校今日停課，並指若紅雨於上午10時30分或之前取消或改為黃雨，下午校會如常上課。民政事務總署早前開放臨時庇護中心。
天文台預料今日大致多雲，稍後驟雨逐漸減少，日間最高氣溫約30度。明日及星期六有幾陣驟雨，日間酷熱。
